name: @yaoyu/geo-engine
description: Renderer-agnostic GIS engine core: ingest any polygon GeoJSON/TopoJSON, region tree, drill state machine, data binding, globe↔plane projection math, plugins.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --sourcemap --external:@yaoyu/geo-data --outfile=dist/index.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
